title: Horizon
overview: A weather application built with Angular and TypeScript that fetches real-time weather data from an external API.
description: A weather app that uses OpenWeather API to fetch temps daily, hourly, and weekly.
features: City-based weather search that shows daily, hourly, and weekly forecasts
API data handling and error states
Dynamic toggle states between metric and imperial
challenges: Handling asynchronous API calls and managing application state in Angular.

title: Whisk
overview: A full-stack e-commerce bakery website built with a MERN stack.
features: A complex data model that can handle products, shopping carts, and checkout.
A user view to shop and an admin view to manage products.
Created a text sandbox payment with Paypal.
challenges: Creating a test playground for simulated payments using Paypal.

title: Todos
overview: A to-do app with a focus on varius CSS design tools and CRUD operations.
features: Todo app that handles basic CRUD operations
challenges: Creating different todo lists for specific projects with different deadlines.
